create_Ovis2Config: create an Ovis2Config instance with default vision and text sub-configs for the Ovis2 multimodal model
create_Ovis2VisionConfig: create an Ovis2VisionConfig instance with default vision transformer settings for Ovis2
build_Ovis2Config_from_dict: build an Ovis2Config from a dictionary by passing vision_config and text_config as nested dicts
initialize_Ovis2Config_with_sub_configs: initialize an Ovis2Config that auto-constructs Ovis2VisionConfig and Qwen2Config sub-configs
configure_Ovis2_visual_indicator_tokens: configure Ovis2Config with custom visual_indicator_token_ids and image_token_id for image prompt encoding
